scope: Post-open necessary-capacity attribution for the independently validated negative v237 causal FIFO16 plus one-current-direction mechanism. This audit asks whether the complete linear span reachable before the frozen FIFO update can possibly satisfy each frozen metric gate. It does not select deployment coefficients and cannot establish joint feasibility when the four metric-wise optima use different coefficients.

frozen_data_and_physics.dataset: the same already opened public BLASTNet hydrogen-air Case 7 density sequence used by v235 and v237
frozen_data_and_physics.reported_operator: the same clean reported straight-ray operator per rig as v235 and v237
frozen_data_and_physics.preconditioner: the same exact geometry-Jacobi inverse diagonal with relative floor 1e-6
frozen_data_and_physics.reference: the independently validated v235 zero-start geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 metrics
frozen_data_and_physics.truth_use: only the offline metric-specific least-squares capacity calculation and scoring; never the cache, current direction, operator, update, rank rule, or any deployable selector

unique_primary.name: dynamic_preupdate_fifo16_plus_current_k1_reachable_span_metricwise_oracle
unique_primary.causal_rebuild: Rebuild the exact v237 frame-zero K16 cache. For each later frame, compute x0=U(Q^T y), run exactly one unchanged geometry-Jacobi PCGLS iteration, retain the pre-update cache U,Q and that iteration's raw paired direction p,Ap, score the span [U,p], then apply the unchanged v237 FIFO update before the next frame.
unique_primary.reachable_span: All fields Uc+beta*p reachable by arbitrary coefficients in the frozen pre-update FIFO16 cache plus the current raw K1 direction. No rank, depth, reset, update, operator, preconditioner, or data change is allowed.

metricwise_designs.field_relative_l2: mean-center every field basis column and the truth field, then minimize Euclidean residual
metricwise_designs.gradient_relative_l2: apply the frozen physical np.gradient discretization and spacings to every field basis column and truth, then minimize Euclidean residual over all gradient entries
metricwise_designs.interior_gradient_relative_l2: use the same gradient arrays restricted to two cells from every field boundary, then minimize Euclidean residual
metricwise_designs.observation_relative_l2: use the exact paired projected cache Q plus the current exact Ap direction and minimize residual to the current observation

unique_primary.formal_minimum_solver: NumPy reduced singular-value decomposition with retained singular values s > eps*max(rows,columns)*s_max; reconstruct the residual explicitly before normalization
unique_primary.independent_minimum_solver: independently rebuilt basis and SciPy column-pivoted economic QR with retained diagonal magnitudes > eps*max(rows,columns)*max(abs(diag(R))); project onto the retained Q columns and reconstruct the residual explicitly
unique_primary.rank_rule: Rank deficiency is a scientific property of the reachable metric image, not an execution failure. Formal and independent numerical ranks must agree for every cell and metric.
unique_primary.frame_zero_rule: Frame zero is fixed to the sealed K16 reference metrics and contributes ratio one to complete-rig tails; no frame-zero truth-aware coefficient optimization is used.
unique_primary.interpretation_boundary: The four minima may use four different coefficient vectors. Passing every necessary bound proves only necessary-capacity headroom and does not prove one jointly feasible field exists.
forbidden_variants: CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet, or GPU rescue

accuracy_contract.necessary_cell_rule: For every later cell and every metric, the metric-specific minimum must satisfy both its absolute cell limit and 1.05 times the sealed K16 metric.
accuracy_contract.necessary_complete_rig_rule: Combine the fixed frame-zero K16 metric with the 41 later metric-specific minima. Every metric's absolute and K16-relative p90-higher and worst lower bounds must satisfy the frozen complete-rig limits.

cost_accounting.truth_aware_metricwise_least_squares: offline diagnostic with no deployment ledger and no speed claim
cost_accounting.geometry_jacobi_setup: offline setup, separately disclosed and unchanged

validity_and_independence.independent_implementation: The validator must not import the formal runner or v237 recycling numerical core. It independently rebuilds PCGLS, MGS/FIFO cache, metric designs, QR minima, summaries, permutation audit, and the final decision.

decision_order: Any parent, source, payload, operator, preconditioner, cache, exact-call, finite-array, rank-agreement, permutation, or independent-recomputation failure makes v240 INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_CASE7_CAUSAL_REACHABLE_SPAN_CAPACITY_V240.

If any later cell has a metric-specific minimum above either its frozen absolute or matched cell threshold, or any complete-rig metric lower-bound tail exceeds its frozen absolute or matched threshold, conclude FAIL_CASE7_CAUSAL_REACHABLE_SPAN_NECESSARY_CAPACITY_V240. This closes the entire frozen pre-update FIFO16 plus current-K1 linear span, not merely the v237 c=Q^T y coefficient rule.

Only if every one of 533 later cells and all 13 complete-rig metric lower-bound tails pass may conclude POST_OPEN_CASE7_CAUSAL_REACHABLE_SPAN_NECESSARY_HEADROOM_V240. This is necessary but not sufficient; a separately preregistered joint convex feasibility audit is then required before any selector or predictor.
No v240 outcome authorizes training, physical deployment, resource measurement, external generalization, or real BOST claims.
